title: AGENTS.md - scSpotlight Development Guide
text: JavaScript: - Use regl-scatterplot WebGL-accelerated main scatter plots (canvas/SVG) - Use TypedArrays (Float32Array, Int32Array, Int16Array) large numeric data - Store categorical data index arrays level lookup, string arrays - Debounce resize handlers (250ms) prevent excessive redraws - Purge webR shelter operation free memory - Avoid DOM manipulation tight loops R: - Use DuckDB -disk expression matrix queries (avoid loading full matrix) - Use qs package fast binary serialization (qsave/qread_url) - Use ExtendedTask + future_promise non-blocking async operations - Use scattermore::geom_scattermost() R-generated plots cells > 30K - Consider BPCells large sparse matrices

"processing" mode allows users process input data Seurat package "viewer" mode, user able view dimension reduction result query gene expressions. maxSize Maximum allowed total size (bytes) global variables identified, see future.globals.maxSize. nCores Number threads use (future::plan()). ... arguments pass golem_opts.
